runtime_target_transport: none: offline, scripted models, no audio and no transport
provider_model_settings: pydantic-ai FunctionModel; ALLOW_MODEL_REQUESTS=False, so a real provider request raises rather than being made
command_or_scenario_recipe: PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 GOOGLE_API_KEY=offline-test-placeholder .venv/bin/python -B -c 'import sys, runpy; import pydantic_ai.models as models; models.ALLOW_MODEL_REQUESTS = False; runpy.run_module(sys.argv[1], run_name="__main__")' tests.test_flow
expected: Actual offered schemas plus direct stale/illegal execution refusal; success-only movement; deterministic conflict refusal
actual: 12 checks passed. Offered destinations are read off the wire per model request and narrow mid-run when a tool changes the state. A destination whose guard closed is refused at execution. A move requires a tool that returned, not one that was called. Two actions in one reply: the winner is chosen from the complete response in emission order before anything executes, and the loser is refused before its service runs -- five repeats give one outcome.
limitations: Offline and scripted. No real provider accepted these schemas, no audio was synthesised or recognised, and no carrier was involved. Nothing here transfers to a live call.

before_tool_execute does not fire for output tools in pydantic-ai 2.46.0, verified by probe. Output tools enforce the claim themselves on entry. That is a property of this SDK version and must be rechecked on upgrade.
The conflict policy is a POC experiment, not demonstrated provider compliance.
